liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I'll Be Your Baby Tonight** (1 review, 1 other source): Jerry Garcia played pedal steel on this song during the Dylan set; Jerry Garcia played pedal steel on this song [1][21]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): The first set opened with several songs from In The Dark, aimed at fans of the new album [15]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Reviewer called this version blistering, lifting the energy of the first set [24]
- **Joey** (1 review): Reviewer disliked the Dylan set's version of this song, calling it a punishment to listen to [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Times They Are A-Changin'**: rare: 5 archived performances [27]
- **Man Of Peace**: rare: 5 archived performances [27]
- **I'll Be Your Baby Tonight**: rare: 5 archived performances [27]
- **John Brown**: rare: 5 archived performances [27]
- **I Want You**: rare: 4 archived performances [27]
- **Ballad Of A Thin Man**: rare: 10 archived performances [27]
- **Chimes Of Freedom**: rare: 6 archived performances [27]
- **Slow Train**: rare: 5 archived performances [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-07-04.sbd.miller.101650.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 190 min; rated 3.4/5 by 15 [1]
- **gd1987-07-04.143052.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 194 min [2]
- **gd1987-07-04.143049.dts.tobin.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 194 min [3]
- **gd1987-07-04.143048.mtx.tobin.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 194 min [4]

## Around the show

- Hot, humid July 4th; fans drank and smoked on scorching asphalt, arriving dehydrated, and a shirtless man with eyeball tattoos approached them [17]
- Traffic into Foxboro crawled for two hours, a car overheated, and a sign at the gate warned against bringing alcohol [18]
- Stadium was oversold and crowded; ticket takers were overwhelmed, so this listener walked in without a ticket check [19]
- Band and Dylan stayed at the same hotel; Dylan arrived by helicopter in leather amid sweltering heat and stopped traffic [22]
- Commenter mentions gate-crashers beaten by police and meeting Bill Walton at shows; unclear tie to this concert [25]
- Every song in the second set was sung by Dylan [1]
- Opening show of the tour; Dylan joined the Dead for the entire second set [30]
- Reviewer found it far tamer than the five earlier shows on the summer tour's first leg [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-07-04.sbd.miller.101650.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD [1]
- **gd1987-07-04.143052.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16/48kHz ; 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) - SBD (shnid = 101650) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional… [2]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user; FLAC conversion made 30 August 2018 by Trader Little Helper [2]
- **gd1987-07-04.143049.dts.tobin.flac1644**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix; ; SBD (shnid = 101650) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> FLAC; All… [3]. Also: DTS 5.1 surround version for audio CD, needing a digital connection to play back [3]
- **gd1987-07-04.143048.mtx.tobin.flac1644**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid = 101650) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> FLAC; All… [4]. Also: Soundboard plus audience matrix mix, mixed by an archive.org user; FLAC conversion 30 August 2018 [4]
